name: airbrake_notices
title: Read Airbrake notices
description: Airbrake notices (individual error occurrences). list and get_status are documented; get hits an undocumented dashboard endpoint that currently works on hosted Airbrake. group_id and notice_id MUST be passed as strings (19-digit snowflakes). List results include `_pagination.has_more`/`next_page`. Returns the raw Airbrake JSON payload — no data is removed unless list is given `fields` (keeps only those top-level keys per item).

fields.description: List actions only: keep just these top-level keys (exact names as Airbrake returns them, e.g. ["id","createdAt"]) on each listed item. Omit for the full payload.

notice_uuid.description: UUID returned when the notice was first reported
